opponents.name: Pirate Lord
utility: Point Defence, Ammo 10. more corrupt dictatorships and feudal autocracies. Such police departments can become a cause of crime, or even the instigators of it, leading to much suffering and unnecessary woe. Stations and planets that have small populations rarely have police forces. Instead, the company or group that is exploiting the system will employ a private security firm to double as law officers as well as property guards. Small communities rarely suffer the kind of intense criminal activity that developed worlds have, and so this doubling of duties is not too onerous.
